notes_for_editor: Thin record: one row in the tnlandforms Georgia list. The elevation column has no unit (138 read as feet gives the record's 42.1 m). The codes BLL-65149 and the tag 'usgs' are not explained on any crawled page, so the story does not interpret them. The list's header says names for towers 73 and above are the compiler's own, so 'braganza' may not be a historical name. Two web searches found no history for this tower. The NHLR Georgia list, the FFLOS Georgia cache and the Eastern U.S. Lookouts Georgia list (69 entries) contain no Braganza. A community profile at roadsidethoughts.com gives the Braganza area 140 ft; it was not used, since no story sentence depends on it. The story is 133 words, above the 120-word floor.
